about: The session's locale as an application gets it (docs/adr/0040-language-and-region.mdx, decisions 3 and 4; sample/LocaleProbe.tsx), live. The run's environment is es_ES.UTF-8 and the person has chosen nothing, so the session tells the probe es-ES (Locale, event 181) at connect, before its bundle runs: React Native's I18nManager says es_ES, as Android does, left to right; expo-localization's getLocales() is es-ES (Spanish, Spain, no script, comma decimal and dot grouping as CLDR has them, metric, Celsius, no currency) and getCalendars() Gregorian, 24 hours, Monday first (2, CLDR's weekData) in the run's time zone; Intl's default locale (DateTimeFormat's resolved locale, toLocaleTimeString() and PluralRules with no locale) is es-ES; oxyos/locale.js's useSessionLocale() is es-ES-u-hc-h23. The probe, granted `settings` as the session grants Settings, then changes the preferences one at a time, and each time the session tells it its new locale and the host tells expo-localization's listeners once each (onLocaleSettingsChanged, onCalendarSettingsChanged) and reports it (`locale`): hour_cycle h12 makes es-ES-u-hc-h12 (12 hours: 3:04:05 p. m., as ICU 78.3 formats it, its spaces narrow no-break ones); region MX makes es-MX-u-hc-h12 (dot decimal, comma grouping, Sunday first, 3:04:05 p.m.); language en makes en-MX-u-hc-h12 (English: an ordinal 2 is `two`, 3:04:05 PM). I18nManager's identifier stays the one the host started with, as Android's constants do. A host that kept Intl's default from its start, or cached it in JavaScript, fails at the first change; one that told no change event, at the counts.
